terms.title: Rental terms
terms.subtitle: Transparent rules, no surprises
terms.importantText: The car is handed over upon presentation of a national passport and a driving license valid in the Russian Federation. Pick-up / return — daily from 10:00 to 19:00. Off-hours — by tariff.

age.title: Age and experience
age.text: Minimum age — 23 years. Driving experience — at least 3 years. Minimum rental period — one day.

docs.title: Documents
docs.text: National passport and driving license valid in the Russian Federation.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.text: Deposit depends on the car class. Refunded on the return day if there is no damage.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.text: OSAGO included in the price. KASKO — optional.

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.text: We hand over with a full tank, return with a full tank. Or pay the difference by receipt.

return.title: Car return
return.text: Return in the same condition. Full car wash — 1 000 ₽ if the car is returned dirty.
